properties: Fast and flashy, seats two or three If desired, the group can ignore ammunition amounts for guns, bows, and the like and simply rely on GM intrusions to indicate when one runs out of ammo. Running out of ammo is a great and easy intrusion for when a player rolls a 1 with a weapon that uses it.
